# 3ware Ltd .github repository

This repository hosts the README displayed on the [3ware GitHub organisation page](../profile/README.md) and the default community health files shared across all 3ware repositories.

See the [contributing guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md). Changes are reviewed by `@3ware/repo-maintainers`, as defined in [CODEOWNERS](CODEOWNERS).
